assumptions: SIGNAL IS BACK AT DESIGN 4.1 (the lead's instruction; spec History 2026-11-14, built). The item is written removing when rules 1 to 6 have passed and before its remover is called. Row signal/removing-while-the-remover-runs: the remover sees the item removing, the journal grows by signal, removing and removed; a process killed inside the remover leaves the item removing with the event and the emitter recorded; when the ledger refuses that write the remover is not handed the item. Falsifier space345-due-while-the-remover-runs turns the row red. Suite 139 runs the keeper itself since this change.

THE LEDGER READS THE KEEP RECORD ITSELF. Row keep/ledger-reads-itself: a ref the repository does not hold or holds at another commit, a ref outside the item's own, a repository the declarations do not name or named through .., a snapshot path outside the store, written with .., or a link, a missing folder and a manifest with another digest are each refused by name with nothing written; neither host principal may sign keep; a later write adds and never moves. This is not a criterion of the spec; it is the keep command of design 6.1.

NOT PROVEN ON A REAL FULL DISK OR BY A REAL KILL. A full pool is the keeper's own write replaced for one attempt (it writes half a block and raises no space left, or returns short); a kill is an exception no handler catches, raised at the named point in the suite's own process. No process was sent a signal and no filesystem was filled.

TWO FALSIFIERS ARE APPLIED IN A NARROWER FORM (spec History 2026-11-14, built). The agent worktree's refs in its agent repository is stopped by the ledger's own check one step before the loss. The snapshot as a commit on a kept ref is applied as its files written into the main repository's object store.

RECONCILE IS NOT BUILT (VELDO-0315). "By reconcile" in AC3 is shown by control_space_keep.verify, the check reconcile must pass before it completes an item, and by a second attempt made the way reconcile will make it. The snapshot is written only when the keeper is made with snapshot=True; the removals that ask for one are VELDO-0318, 0336 and 0347, and no remover here forces a removal.

A KEPT REF IS NEVER MOVED, so an item whose head moved after a deferred attempt is keep_failed until its kept refs are dropped (VELDO-0346). Nothing is lost by it; it can leave a worktree waiting (spec History).
FOUND, NOT FIXED: the registered case space331-signal-reads-no-mode has had no anchor in control_space_signal.py since VELDO-0301 (it is absent at 27164fc4 too).
The full gate, the heavy suites and the teeth stage were not run by the builder.
rollback: Revert the change. Removers then run without the keep step, as before this ticket. Kept refs already written stay in their repositories and are still read by plain git.
